question: Should maintainers accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94416 as the canonical Matrix missing-key recovery fix, request an API-boundary reshape, or prefer another candidate?
rationale: The bug is source-supported and already has open implementation candidates, but the retained exhausted-retry state and SDK retry-path behavior need Matrix owner acceptance before this issue can close.

options.title: Land The Focused Bridge Fix
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94416 after normal checks, then close this issue and supersede overlapping attempts.

options.title: Request An API Boundary
options.body: Ask the PR author to reshape the retry through an approved Matrix API seam before merge if direct bridge use of MatrixEvent.attemptDecryption is not acceptable.

options.title: Prefer A Different Candidate
options.body: Name another canonical PR and close or supersede the others so the Matrix missing-key fix does not split across competing branches.

recommendation.title: Land The Focused Bridge Fix
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94416 after normal checks, then close this issue and supersede overlapping attempts.

likelyOwner.reason: gumadeiras has the strongest feature-history signal for the Matrix SDK/decrypt bridge and sync lifecycle surfaces involved in the decision.
